newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukrainian president to visit Greece.
newsitem.headline: Ukrainian president to visit Greece.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma will visit Greece from November 11 to 13 to boost political and business ties between the two countries, his press office said on Wednesday.
Kuchma is due to sign a Friendship Treaty with Greek President Costis Stephanopoulos and economic agreements with Prime Minister Costas Simitis.
Ukraine has a $51-million positive trade balance with Greece and wants to increase export of metals and output in its chemical industry.
Ukrainian shipyards have been building tankers and refrigerators for Greek firms and have enough orders to last at least until 1999.
The former Soviet republic has a 100,000-strong Greek community in the east and south of the country.
